title: Horizontal Stretch of a Cubic Polynomial
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Give an equation for the graph of y = 1 - x^3 after it is stretched horizontally by a factor of 2.

steps.title: Recall the Horizontal Stretch Rule
steps.explanation: To stretch the graph of y = f(x) horizontally by a factor of c > 1, replace x with x / c.
steps.why: Replacing x with x/c multiplies every x-coordinate by c.

steps.title: Substitute x / 2 for x in y = 1 - x^3
steps.explanation: With horizontal stretch factor c = 2, replace x with x / 2.
steps.why: Direct substitution of x/2 for x.

steps.title: Simplify the Cubed Fraction
steps.explanation: Cubing x/2 gives x^3 / 8, so the stretched equation is y = 1 - x^3 / 8 (stretching the x-intercept from (1, 0) to (2, 0)).
